## Summary

**Phase 6 — the vertical slice (HARD SYNCHRONIZATION GATE, §54 / SIG-ENG-034).**
Carry one **real** jurisdiction — Oklahoma City (OKCPD Flock Safety ALPR, Master
Agreement C241032) — from evidence to a rendered dossier, to **falsify the design
on real data before scaling it** (§51.1). J-1 executes end to end; every material
fact resolves to a document at a locator; the count predicates stay distinct with
`PREDICATE_CONFLATION` firing on a deliberate conflation; and a genuine
contradiction renders without collapse.

Phase 6 is deliberately sequenced **before** the reconciliation engine (P08),
records/parsing (P07), the portal layer (P11), and the API/web surfaces
(P14/P15). This PR builds the *minimal* purpose-built machinery the slice needs
(do not gold-plate — P08/P15.2 supersede it) and records what the design got
wrong. Implements docs/tickets/P06.1__vertical-slice.md. Spec anchors: §2.2 J-1,
Appendix D, §29.1, §39.2, §51–54.

## What changed
- **reconcile/** — minimal count-reconciliation seed (ADR-031):
  - weight.py — composed weight W (§10.6, SIG-EPIS-021) + derived currency C
    (§28.3, SIG-RECON-008), reproducing the Appendix D.2 worked case exactly
    (incl. the machine-readable-structured-export +1 upgrade).
  - counts.py — §29.1 per-basis resolution, the PREDICATE_CONFLATION guard,
    mapped as a lower bound, unresolved deltas -> research tasks
    (SIG-RECON-026/027/028/029). model.py — thin value objects.
- **exports/dossier.py** — minimal §39.2 dossier renderer (SIG-UI-010..015): the
  twelve sections in order, "what we don't know" in summary+API+print, the
  incompleteness banner, a print-CSS PDF path, every material figure expandable
  to its reconciliation. Superseded by P15.2 (ADR-032).
- **ontology/** — add the three missing §29.1 count predicates
  (invoiced_/mapped_/claimed_device_count), additive + regenerated (ADR-031).
- **tests/acceptance/** — the OKC evidence fixtures, the slice graph/dossier
  assembly, and the J-1 acceptance query (SIG-CHART-009/010), Docker-free.
- **docs/slice/** — the pre-registered hardness precondition (declared before the
  slice) and the committed retrospective (the hard-gate artifact).
- **traceability + risk register** updated; **ADR-031 / ADR-032** written.

## The slice numbers (real, multi-sourced)
90 contracted (W4) · 90 active (W2) · **299 mapped** (W2, lower bound) · claimed
190-vs-299 disagreement retained. The -209 mapped-over-active surplus becomes an
operator-attribution research task; PREDICATE_CONFLATION fires on conflating
contracted 90 with mapped 299. Sources: OKC procurement (Master Agreement
C241032), the 2026-08-18 council renewal, DeFlock's community map, OKCPD
Operations Manual §5-118, Oklahoma statute 47 O.S. §7-606.1, and reporting by the
Journal Record, The Oklahoman, KGOU/KOSU.

## What the design got wrong (retrospective highlights)
- Registry shipped with 3 of the 6 §29.1 count predicates missing (fixed here).
- Appendix D.2's published W for OSM-mapped only follows from §10.6 via an
  unstated +1 upgrade.
- The count model conflates *basis* with *scope*: metro-mapped 299 > city-active
  90 inverts the Appendix-D delta ordering.
- count_basis is load-bearing in §29.1 but has no home in the schema; the
  generated Contradiction/ResearchTask models are thinner than the DB tables.
Full detail in docs/slice/P06.1_retrospective.md.

## Method note
Phase 6 runs before the connectors that would acquire this data (P07/P11), so the
slice's evidence is committed fixtures faithfully transcribing cited public
sources (each artifact's real URL is its stable_locator, bytes content-addressed
to a real capture digest, each claim's locator pinned to a span). The slice
proves the shape end to end and falsifies the model; live acquisition is P07/P11.
